newsitem.title: USA: Illinois' corn six percent harvested vs 21 average.
newsitem.headline: Illinois' corn six percent harvested vs 21 average.

text.p: Illinois's corn crop was six percent harvested as of Sunday while soybeans were four percent harvested, the state's Agricultural Statistics Service said in its weekly crop update.
Last year, 21 percent of the corn was cut along with 18 percent of the soybeans.
Corn was rated 13 percent excellent, 41 percent good, 31 percent fair, 11 percent poor and four percent very poor.
Soybeans were rated six percent excellent, 36 percent good, 40 fair, 13 percent poor and five percent very poor.
Rain provided much-needed moisture for late planted soybeans but disrupted harvest of more mature fields.
The corn was 59 percent mature as of Sunday, against 80 percent on average. Forty-five percent of the soybeans were dropping leaves, compared with 82 percent on average.
Soil moisture was rated seven percent surplus, 63 percent adequate, 25 percent short and five percent very short.
Pasture and range were rated three percent excellent, 25 percent good, 34 percent fair, 28 percent poor and 10 percent very poor.
